OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector (ISO-8601 duration, e.g. 'PT1H').

STIXIFY_BASE_URL.description: The URL of the Stixify API.

STIXIFY_API_KEY.description: The Stixify API key used for authentication.

STIXIFY_DOSSIER_IDS.description: Comma-separated list of Stixify Dossier IDs. The Reports (and the objects extracted from them) in these Dossiers are imported into OpenCTI. The Dossiers must be visible to the team of the API key. At least one Dossier ID is needed: the connector stops at startup when none is set.
